title: Blessed animal bladders hung on the fence line
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Blessed animal bladders hung on the fence line, about 2016 at Skinwalker Ranch perimeter, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the the the Native Americans have been hanging these and blessing these animal bladders

plain: Brandon Fugal owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. He told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that around 2016 he found that Native Americans had been hanging animal bladders along the ranch's fence line and blessing them, and he connects this to the security staff who worked there under an earlier owner named Bigelow. If true, it would suggest that local people treated the land as something that needed spiritual guarding.
